tracks.title: 還差一個宋江
tracks.genre: Mandarin melodica-and-fingerpicking small-town minjian folk (民謠)
tracks.subject: a man in his late thirties who still keeps a biscuit tin of 107 instant-noodle collector cards from his school years, missing only the 'Song Jiang' card he swapped away at the playground in 1998, and at the class reunion the classmate pulls the worn card from his wallet
